001package io.github.ai4ci.config.setup;
002
003import org.immutables.value.Value;
004
005import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonIgnore;
006import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeInfo;
007import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeName;
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonDeserialize;
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonSerialize;
010
011import io.github.ai4ci.abm.ImmutablePersonDemographic;
012import io.github.ai4ci.abm.ModifiablePerson;
013import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Outbreak;
014import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Person;
015import io.github.ai4ci.functions.EmpiricalDistribution;
016import io.github.ai4ci.functions.EmpiricalFunction;
017import io.github.ai4ci.functions.ImmutableEmpiricalDistribution;
018import io.github.ai4ci.functions.ImmutableEmpiricalFunction;
019import io.github.ai4ci.functions.LinkFunction;
020import io.github.ai4ci.functions.SimpleFunction;
021import io.github.ai4ci.util.Conversions;
022import io.github.ai4ci.util.Sampler;
023
024/**
025 * Age stratified demographic configuration and helpers.
026 *
027 * <p>
028 * This interface describes a simple age stratified demography used during setup
029 * and baselining. It supplies an empirical age distribution and a function
030 * expressing the odds of contact as a function of age difference.
031 * Implementations are used when creating person stubs and when computing
032 * relationship strengths between agents.
033 *
034 * <p>
035 * Downstream uses include setup and builder code such as
036 * {@link io.github.ai4ci.flow.builders.DefaultModelBuilder#setupOutbreak(io.github.ai4ci.abm.ModifiableOutbreak, io.github.ai4ci.config.setup.SetupConfiguration, io.github.ai4ci.util.Sampler)}
037 * and per‑person baselining in
038 * {@link io.github.ai4ci.flow.builders.DefaultPersonBaseliner#baselinePerson(io.github.ai4ci.abm.ImmutablePersonBaseline.Builder, io.github.ai4ci.abm.Person, io.github.ai4ci.util.Sampler)}.
039 * The {@link #createPersonStub(Outbreak)} helper samples ages for new
040 * {@link io.github.ai4ci.abm.Person} instances during setup.
041 *
042 * @author Rob Challen
043 */
044@Value.Immutable
045@JsonSerialize(as = ImmutableAgeStratifiedDemography.class)
046@JsonDeserialize(as = ImmutableAgeStratifiedDemography.class)
047@JsonTypeInfo(use = JsonTypeInfo.Id.NAME)
048@JsonTypeName("age-stratified")
049@SuppressWarnings("immutables")
050public interface AgeStratifiedDemography extends LocationAwareDemography {
051
052        /**
053         * Sensible default age stratified demography used in examples and tests.
054         *
055         * <p>
056         * The default supplies a simple age distribution and an odds function that
057         * describes relative contact likelihood by age difference. Tests and
058         * examples may rely on this instance as a compact baseline.
059         */
060        ImmutableAgeStratifiedDemography DEFAULT = ImmutableAgeStratifiedDemography
061                .builder()
062                .setDescription(
063                        "A test empirical demographic distribution and function for the odds of contact by age difference"
064                )
065                .setAgeDistribution(
066                        ImmutableEmpiricalDistribution.builder()
067                                .setMinimum(0)
068                                .setMaximum(120)
069                                .setX(18, 45, 65, 85)
070                                .setCumulativeProbability(0.1, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9)
071                                .build()
072                )
073                .setOddsContactFromAgeDifference(
074                        ImmutableEmpiricalFunction.builder()
075                                .setX(0, 10, 25, 40, 60, 70)
076                                .setY(2, 0.5, 1.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5)
077                                .setLink(LinkFunction.LOG)
078                                .build()
079                )
080                .setContactProximityBias(2.0)
081                .build();
082
083        /**
084         * Adjust a base contact probability by the age difference between two
085         * people.
086         *
087         * <p>
088         * This helper converts the supplied base probability {@code p} into an
089         * adjusted probability using the normalised age‑difference odds ratio. The
090         * odds ratio is applied using {@link Conversions#scaleProbabilityByOR} to
091         * preserve valid probability semantics.
092         *
093         * @param p   base contact probability
094         * @param one source person
095         * @param two target person
096         * @return a probability adjusted for age-based contact odds
097         */
098        default double adjustedProbabilityContact(double p, Person one, Person two) {
099                var age1 = one.getDemographic()
100                        .getAge();
101                var age2 = two.getDemographic()
102                        .getAge();
103                var diff = Math.abs(age1 - age2);
104                return Conversions.scaleProbabilityByOR(
105                        p,
106                        this.getNormalisedOddsContactFromAgeDifference()
107                                .value(diff)
108                );
109        }
110
111        /**
112         * Create a modifiable person stub and populate the person's age from the
113         * configured age distribution.
114         *
115         * <p>
116         * This helper is a convenience used during outbreak setup when the builder
117         * needs to create a population quickly. Downstream callers include the setup
118         * stage in {@link io.github.ai4ci.flow.builders.DefaultModelBuilder}. The
119         * returned {@link ModifiablePerson} has an
120         * {@link ImmutablePersonDemographic} with an age sampled from
121         * {@link #getAgeDistribution()}.
122         *
123         * @param outbreak the owning outbreak used to attach the created person
124         * @return a modifiable person with a sampled age demographic
125         */
126        @Override
127        default ModifiablePerson createPersonStub(Outbreak outbreak) {
128                var tmp = Person.createPersonStub(outbreak);
129                tmp.setDemographic(
130                        ImmutablePersonDemographic.builder()
131                                .from(tmp.getDemographic())
132                                .setAge(
133                                        this.getAgeDistribution()
134                                                .sample()
135                                )
136                                .build()
137                );
138                return tmp;
139        }
140
141        /**
142         * The demographics of the population.
143         *
144         * @return an empirical cumulative distribution describing population ages
145         */
146        EmpiricalDistribution getAgeDistribution();
147
148        /**
149         * Normalised odds function for age difference.
150         *
151         * <p>
152         * When {@link #getOddsContactFromAgeDifference()} is an
153         * {@link EmpiricalFunction} this method returns a function that has been
154         * normalised against the joint age distribution. The normalisation produces
155         * a baseline odds function suitable for combining with other contact
156         * modifiers.
157         *
158         * @return a normalised odds function for age difference
159         */
160        @JsonIgnore @Value.Default
161        default SimpleFunction getNormalisedOddsContactFromAgeDifference() {
162                if (this.getOddsContactFromAgeDifference() instanceof EmpiricalFunction)
163                        return this.getAgeDistribution()
164                                .combine(this.getAgeDistribution(), (d1, d2) -> Math.abs(d1 - d2))
165                                .getInterpolation()
166                                .baselineOdds(
167                                        ((EmpiricalFunction) this.getOddsContactFromAgeDifference())
168                                );
169                return this.getOddsContactFromAgeDifference();
170        }
171
172        /**
173         * Odds ratio function for making a contact given absolute age difference.
174         *
175         * <p>
176         * The function returns a non‑negative odds ratio for a given absolute age
177         * difference; callers typically normalize or combine this function with
178         * other contact modifiers. If the implementation is an
179         * {@link EmpiricalFunction} it will be normalised by
180         * {@link #getNormalisedOddsContactFromAgeDifference()}.
181         *
182         * @return a function mapping age difference to odds ratio
183         */
184        SimpleFunction getOddsContactFromAgeDifference();
185
186        /**
187         * Compute relationship strength between two people, incorporating age
188         * effects.
189         *
190         * <p>
191         * The default implementation delegates to
192         * {@link LocationAwareDemography#getRelationshipStrength(Person,Person,Sampler)}
193         * then scales the result by the age‑difference adjusted probability via
194         * {@link #adjustedProbabilityContact(double, Person, Person)}. This is the
195         * canonical place to combine location and demographic contact modifiers.
196         *
197         * @param source  the source person
198         * @param target  the target person
199         * @param sampler a sampler used for any stochastic elements in the base
200         *                relationship strength
201         * @return a relationship strength used as an odds/probability modifier
202         */
203        @Override
204        default double getRelationshipStrength(
205                        Person source, Person target, Sampler sampler
206        ) {
207                return this.adjustedProbabilityContact(
208                        LocationAwareDemography.super.getRelationshipStrength(
209                                source,
210                                target,
211                                sampler
212                        ),
213                        source,
214                        target
215                );
216        }
217
218}
